# Ortvest

> Product studio in Poznań, Poland, building marketplaces, P2P products and member networks — platforms that only work once strangers start trusting each other. We specialise in the cold-start problem: who joins on day one, and why they stay while the other side is still empty.

A 15-person team covering engineering, product design and go-to-market. One squad per project, assigned until launch. EU entity, EU-based data and IP handling, European working hours.

Three industries shipped — P2P, community and clubs, logistics — with a fourth (agritech) in build. Some client work is under NDA and not published.

Available in English (/en), Polish (/pl) and Ukrainian (/ua). Links below point to the English version.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://www.ortvest.com/en): What we build, how we approach two-sided products, team, cases and FAQ.
- [About](https://www.ortvest.com/en#about): Why we start with the cold-start question before design.
- [Team](https://www.ortvest.com/en#team): 15 people — 9 engineering, 4 product and design, 2 go-to-market.
- [Services](https://www.ortvest.com/en#services): Design, development and go-to-market, available separately or combined.
- [FAQ](https://www.ortvest.com/en#faq): Cost drivers, scope options, working with existing codebases, what happens after launch.
- [Partnership](https://www.ortvest.com/en/partnership): Working with us as a long-term technical partner rather than an agency.

## Case studies

- [All cases](https://www.ortvest.com/en/cases): Platforms we've built, across P2P, community and logistics.
- [YachtMate](https://www.ortvest.com/en/cases/yachtmate): Private network for yacht club members with real-time communication.
- [SharingGround](https://www.ortvest.com/en/cases/sharingground): Peer-to-peer item sharing platform with trust and logistics systems.
- [Pachaca](https://www.ortvest.com/en/cases/pachaca): Full-stack cleaning and dry-cleaning service platform — mobile apps, web service and internal management system.

## Writing

- [Blog](https://www.ortvest.com/en/blog): Field notes on cold starts, trust systems and marketplace building.
- [The Unglamorous 20%](https://www.ortvest.com/en/blog/marketplace-admin-tooling-operational-features): Why operational tooling — admin panels, moderation queues, dispute handling — decides whether a marketplace survives year one.
- [P2P Platform vs Marketplace](https://www.ortvest.com/en/blog/p2p-platform-vs-marketplace): Why the two aren't the same thing, and how building one like the other kills products.

## Working with us

- [Contact](https://www.ortvest.com/en#contact): Project enquiries. Reply within 24 hours.
- [Discovery Call](https://www.ortvest.com/en#consultation): Free 30-minute fit check. We'll say if the project isn't ours.
- [Cold Start Audit](https://www.ortvest.com/en#consultation): 90-minute paid audit (EUR 199) covering seeding strategy, trust model, architecture and roadmap. Credited in full toward the project.
